Text: Upon arriving at Dreamglow Gardens, the Gray Raven Commandant receives a message from an unknown sender, only to find secretly taken photos of themself. While following the clues, the suspect escapes. At the same time, the Commandant encounters Karenina and Engineering Force technician Dahei, who are also searching for the culprit.
